run_local_dns_server: run a local DNS server on a specified port using a YAML config file for resolver tests
start_dns_server_with_records: start a DNS server that serves A, AAAA, SRV, and TXT records from a YAML configuration
add_dns_a_record: add a one-off A record to the DNS server via the --add_a_record CLI flag
review_NoFileAuthority_class: review the NoFileAuthority class that extends FileAuthority to serve in-memory DNS records
test_dns_server_health_check: test the DNS server health check by querying the health-check-local-dns-server-isalive record
